;"Repository-local Hostile Rooms & Reactive Threats. Release 1262 adds an
  original treasure-guardian dragon and real hoard whose threat watches what the
  Adventurer actually does. Retreat, bargaining, bait and containment, and
  existing mine-fire smoke provide authored approaches without a boss HP layer."
replacements.new:
"ZORK1 ABLATIVE PROTECTION AND EQUIPMENT CONSEQUENCE GLULX for
  Zork I: The Great Underground Empire
  (c) Copyright 1983 Infocom, Inc. All Rights Reserved."

;"Repository-local Ablative Protection & Equipment Consequence. Release 1263
  adds one physical fire screen whose material condition carries the consequence
  of surviving the real dragon's breath. No armor points, durability meter,
  generic block action, repair economy, or universal equipment-damage engine."
